Question: as salaam muftisaheb when i am praying salaat [namaaj] dirty thing are coming in my mind and i am always distrubt so please give me dua or zikhar immediatly . evils thougts are always coming in my mind and brain so please do dua for me muftisaheb. Answer ID: 11770 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 499/499=M/1430) Divert the mind to other things when dirty things come to your mind, do not get yourself lost in the thoughts. Get yourself engaged with full attention in performing the constituents of salah; since the Satan gets hold due to negligence. Recite much durood and keep on praying: رب اعوذبک من ھمزات الشیاطین و اعوذبک رب ان یحضرون اللھم اجعل وساوس قلبی خشیتک و ذکرک واجعل ھمتی وھوای فیما تحب و ترضی Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
